name: lildocs
description: A lightweight CLI that turns Markdown docs into a static searchable documentation site.

scripts.build: tsdown && mkdir -p dist/render && cp src/render/styles.css src/render/search.js src/render/copy-code.js dist/render/
scripts.docs:serve: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.mjs build ./docs --out ./dist/docs && sirv ./dist/docs
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src schemas package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/settings.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src schemas package.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/settings.json
